notes.title: A Mammoth language update
notes.notes:
The Mammoth now has subtitles for the following additional languages:
[list]
[*]Italian
[*]Russian
[*]Thai
[*]Danish
[*]Bulgarian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Japanese
[*]Basque
[*]Turkish
[*]Catalan
[*]Czech

Thanks to everybody who helped contribute translations! We at inbetweengames are very grateful. If you'd like to help, check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/751690/discussions/0/1488866180591964915/]this forum thread[/url]
